devdoc.details: Will charge fees, issue refunds, and run health check on any reported     gains or losses during a strategy's report.

acceptFeeManager().details: This function allows the future fee manager to accept the role change and become the new fee manager.

addVault(address).details: This is not used to set any of the fees for the specific vault or strategy. Each fee will be set separately.

params.vault: The address of a vault to allow to use this accountant.

returns.fee: The config that would be used during the report.

redeemUnderlying(address).details: Will default to using the full balance of the vault.

params.amount: The amount in vault shares to redeem.

params.vault: The vault to remove custom setting for.
The address of the vault to be removed from this accountant.

report(address,uint256,uint256).details: The msg.sender must have been added to the `vaults` mapping.

params.gain: Amount of the gain if any.
params.loss: Amount of the loss if any.

returns.totalRefunds: if any for the vault to pull.

params.customManagement: Custom annual management fee to charge.
params.customMaxFee: Custom max fee to allow as a percent of gain.
params.customMaxGain: Custom max percent gain a strategy can report.
params.customMaxLoss: Custom max percent loss a strategy can report.
params.customRefund: Custom refund ratio to give back on losses.
params.vault: The vault the strategy is hooked up to.

params._futureFeeManager: The address to set as the future fee manager.

params._maxLoss: The amount in basis points to set as the maximum loss.

params.newVaultManager: Address to add or remove vaults.

turnOffHealthCheck(address,address).details: This will only last for one report and get automatically turned back on.

params.defaultManagement: Default annual management fee to charge.
params.defaultMaxFee: Default max fee to allow as a percent of gain.
params.defaultMaxGain: Default max percent gain a strategy can report.
params.defaultMaxLoss: Default max percent loss a strategy can report.
params.defaultRefund: Default refund ratio to give back on losses.

useCustomConfig(address).details: We use uint256 for the flag since its cheaper so this   will convert it to a bool for easy view functions.

returns._0: If a custom fee config is set.
